name: eventstream-variables
description: Prepare target value sets, preserve Eventstream ALM references, verify activation before publication and validate resolved runtime bindings without confusing configuration with event-delivery readiness.

steps.description: Inspect target defaults/value sets and intended resource pointers. Keep exports private; never store credentials in variables.
Preview the complete reviewed definition, including settings.json/valueSets parts. Apply only after approval; replacement can affect existing consumers.
Include required libraries and dependencies. Authored JSON uses symbols, not runtime IDs. Confirm destination item types and target-specific values.
Review variableLibraryPrerequisites and the destructive preview. The target set is not verified by an offline preview; do not guess --env or switch strategy automatically.
After explicit approval, execute the reviewed default-strategy plan. Inspect pre_stream records; failed/uncertain activation halts consumers. Do not replay a failed batch.
Verify that the authored definition still contains symbolic references.
Compare resolved IDs/paths with intended resources. Separately approve/send test events and query the destination; activation alone is not business readiness.

safety: No atomic cutover or automatic pause is provided.
Runtime topology is not a portable authored definition.
Discovery/preview never changes credentials, tenant settings or identity grants.
